title: compact deprecation stripe + new-model launch hero set for quickstart and release notes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact visual asset pack for the Model Catalog release notes: includes a small-width deprecation stripe, new-model hero card variations, localized price-badge overlays, and quickstart screenshot set optimized for small screens and email embeds. Deliverables: Figma file with components, 3x PNG exports (desktop/ tablet/ mobile), accessible SVG stickers for deprecation/launch states, and a short usage guide for Marketing and Docs.
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Kickoff — scoped deliverables with PM. Primary constraints: needs to fit into Docs release notes sidebar (max 480px width) and marketing email templates (max 600px). Confirmed dependent ENG deprecation flags available by 2026-03-08.

2026-03-03 Oliver Patel: Exploratory comps posted in Figma (file link). Focused on three visual directions: minimal stripe, badge-first, and card-with-mini-mock. Requesting accessibility check for contrast on price badges.

2026-03-05 Design critique: Team preferred 'card-with-mini-mock' for clarity; however PM asked to keep a low-visual-weight stripe for sensitive deprecations. Trade-off noted: stripe is low complexity but poor discoverability on mobile; card is discoverable but heavier in density. Agreed to produce both with guidance for when to use each.

2026-03-07 Maya Chen: Added localization proof assets (English, DE, FR) and flagged text length issues for FR; propose truncation rules and two-line wrap patterns. Added TODO for QA with i18n engineer.

2026-03-08 Oliver Patel: First export pack uploaded to Drive: drive.google.com/launch-assets/DES-999321. Linked Confluence usage doc: confluence.redwood.com/display/Catalog/Model+Launch+Assets. Open PR for docs snippets: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1248.

2026-03-09 PM review (Aisha Rahman): Approved visual directions, requested additional microcopy for deprecation stripe to include sunset date and suggested support link. Created follow-up to confirm date string format (YYYY-MM-DD) with ENG.

2026-03-10 Accessibility review (Jared Liu): Contrast ratio passes for dark-mode stripe and badges; recommended increasing hit target on mobile badge to 44px and adding aria-label examples in usage guide.

2026-03-10 Oliver Patel: Tagging release manager and staging for final signoff. Next steps: merge Figma components, export final PNG/SVG/WEBP sets, post to shared Drive and attach to release notes PR.
